# What the CocoaTouch bindings of this fork have to contain — the roots of the cut.
#
# One class name or glob per line ("*" matches anything), dotted names, top-level classes only
# (inner classes come with their outer class). Everything a listed class references is kept as
# well, transitively; see compiler/cocoatouch-prune. A line that matches nothing fails the build:
# upstream renamed or removed the class, and that has to be looked at.
